book.name: Lucas
book.title: Evangelio según Lucas Jesucristo roy pjl̈ú ëre, e jyã tara Lucasdë

content: Woshtozl̈ong dbaryo ga Jesús oppinggaga dwl̈a bo kjrono
Woshtozl̈ong dbaryo kjwara ga Jesús jëk shäng dwl̈a dgak buk l̈i tjrëko ba oppinggaga tjok. Eshko ga ba oppinggaga l̈öng dwl̈a bo kjrë, ga kjwokäya or go, ue l̈ok wl̈o.
Eni ga fariseoga kjone kjone tjl̈ẽ ga «¿L̇l̇ëbo shäryako woshtozl̈ong dbaryoshko l̇l̇ëm l̈i shäryëmi l̈öng kjweni ega?» l̈e.
Kuya Jesúsdë ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «¿Dënashko ga David, ba yorkagaga, e pjl̈i l̈ok arashko ga l̇l̇ëye shäryara tak pjang Sbö tjl̈õkwo go l̈i, e l̈omirë l̇l̇ëmdo?

David opzrëno jek shäng Sbö u roshko, ga pjl̈ung shosho suk pjir iak beno tjeng dboy Sbö kong l̈i uara, ga twara ba nopga jëk l̈öng ba tjok l̈i kong, ue wl̈o bako, e uaga syõshtagagarë erö gueniyo» l̈e.
Ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong obi ga «Woshtozl̈ong dbaryo kägäyo l̈i, no to ter kjok dogo dwayo ëre l̈i e» l̈e.
Woshtozl̈ong dbaryo ga swl̈o poptara Jesúsdë kjl̈ara
Woshtozl̈ong dbaryo obl̈ëshko ga Jesús opzrëno jek judíoga syõ uyo jong kjok eshko l̈i roshko, ga nopga tjeng eshko l̈i pina. Domer shäng kjl̈ara eshko orkwo kël̈ë sl̈osl̈oe.
Fariseoga, no pinggaga kjok l̇l̇gwekkl̈o tara Moisésdë l̈i go, e l̈öng eshko bako, Jesús dë, swl̈o l̈i popte woshtozl̈ong dbaryore ĩya l̈ok wl̈o, rote e go wl̈o.
Wotjl̈ĩk l̈öng l̇l̇ë l̈i miydara Jesúsdë pjir kuzong ga tjl̈ẽ swl̈o l̈i kong ga «Pja kojõs shäng nopga l̈öng kës ëre tjrëko» l̈e. Kuya ga shäryara eni.

E irgo ga Jesús tjl̈ẽ nopga tjeng l̈i kong ga «Pjãy kong l̇l̇ëbo kjakrokër kjrina. ¿Woshtozl̈ong dbaryo ga l̇l̇ëye shäryëy obl̈ë kong ga pjl̈ú? ¿L̇l̇ëbo pjl̈úre, de l̇l̇ëbo owa? ¿Ëre dbaryo ga kjl̈ara buk ba l̇l̇ëmdo shinmotkë wl̈o ga l̇l̇ëye shäryëy? ¿Wẽyẽre, de kjimtëy?» l̈e.
Eshko ga l̈öng ba zl̈ong bäng pjribri l̈i ĩna uunkong, ga tjl̈ẽ swl̈o l̈i kong ga «Pja orkwo roshwĩzong» l̈e. Kuya ga shäryara eni, ga ba orkwo poptono beno pjl̈úe.
Gueniyo ga nopga l̈öng l̈i iirkono ara, tjl̈ẽ l̈ok ëng kong ga «¿L̇l̇ëye shäryëy Jesús kjwe kong ga pjl̈ú?» l̈e.
Jesús domerga kjrono dogl̈o sak kjwara kjingsho pjök (12)
Eshko dbaryo ga Jesús opshino to jem shäng dl̈up jong kjwara bigdo go, syõshtë Sbö kong wl̈o, ga syõshtono shkëe.
Wẽshko kjok shröng ga ba oppinggaga rokara tek l̈öng ba zl̈ong bäng. Eshko ga kjrara dogl̈o sak kjwara kjingsho pjök (12), ber l̈öng Sbö tjl̈õkwo roy l̈aga ba ãska wl̈o. Epga ko l̈ok eni:
Simón, e koiara beno Pedro; Andrés, e Simón l̈ëng; Santiago; Juan; Felipe; Bartolomé;
Mateo; Tomás; Santiago, e Alfeo wa; Simón, e zelote;
Judas, e Santiago wa; Judas Iscariote, e Jesús soynega.
Jesús nopga pino träk l̇l̇ëme

E irgo ga Jesús to ter dl̈up l̈i dwayo ba oppinggaga kjrara l̈i tjok, ga öötong l̈öng sdam l̈ëkong. Eshko ga nopga tjeng träk l̇l̇ëm, opping ba tjok wl̈o. Nopga shrono l̈öng ara ba kuk wl̈o, ba swl̈o l̇l̇ë l̈i popte wl̈o bakoe. Shrono l̈öng l̈i, e Judea sopga, Jerusalén sopga, Tiro sopga, Sidón sopga bakoe. Tiro kjokyo, Sidón kjokyo, e tjeng dl̈ung sor go. Ëye tjeng eshko goshko Ä sëyaga ga e poptara Jesúsdë.
Eshko ga ëye ba shwong porwono ga poptono ba dbo kësbang go. E kjĩshko ga uunkong wotjl̈ĩk l̈ok ba porwë l̈e.
L̇l̇ëye shäryëy, shji ber l̈öng wopjl̈ú wl̈o
Eshko ga ba oppinggaga ĩya Jesúsdë ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga

content.text: l̇l̇ono ga pjãy ber l̈öng bö tjung kjĩshko.
l̇l̇ono ga pjãy ber l̈öng jar kjĩshko.
Pjãy ĩywaba shjiktëng, pjãy wl̈okjrëba l̇l̇ëm, pjãy l̈ãywëba owa, bomi ko e owa l̈ëba, shäryëba eni no to ter kjok dogo dwayo ëre kjĩshkoshko ga

Eni ga pjãy äär kjok dogoshko ga pjãy potjwl̈ẽn ara. E kjĩshko ga shäryëba owa bomi kong enishko ga pjãy woydë l̇l̇ëme. Pjãy ber woowa l̇l̇ëm dey. Sgl̈ik l̈ëmi, öö l̈ëmi ara, pjãy l̈öng wopjl̈ú kjĩshko bakoe.
Dënashko ga Sbö tjl̈õkwo l̈agaga shdunaba eni bakoe.
Gueniyo ga pjãy nopga dbur ara wl̈eniyo,
l̇l̇ono ga pjãy l̈öng pjl̈ú dbaryo l̈i pjitong kjĩshko.
l̇l̇ono ga pjãy ber l̈öng pjl̈i ara kjĩshko.
l̇l̇ono ga pjãy ber l̈öng sl̈ar ëë kjĩshko.
Dënashko ga nopga to l̈öng tjl̈ẽ ga “Tja Sbö tjl̈õkwo l̈aga” l̈e, gueniyo ichaga Sbörë l̇l̇ëme. Eshko ga epga poshrëraba ara bakoe.

content: Bi moskwoga woydëy ara
»Gueniyo ga l̈ër pjãy bor kuga l̈i kong ga bomi moskwoga woydozĩ ara. Ëye, pjãy ĩywa shjiktëng ga kong l̇l̇ëbo shäryozĩ pjl̈ú dey.
Ëye wotjl̈ĩk owa bop tjok ga pjãy wotjl̈ĩk pjl̈ú ba tjok. Ëye, pjãy bokrotke ga pjãy syõshtë Sbö kong ba kjĩshko dey.
Pjãy kwomso shpora obl̈ërë pjl̈ara ga kal̈ëkong twëmi ba kong, shpoya wl̈o bakoe. Bomi shwong kop l̈ëkong döra ga bomi shwong ter l̈ëkong twëmi ba kong bakoe.
Ë pogo tjwe bomi shwoy l̇l̇ëbo rokë ga twëmi ba kong. L̇l̇ëbo döra bop shjiryo ga wẽyẽ.
Pjãy l̇l̇ëbo shäryos obl̈ë kong, woydëmi ga shärye l̈ok bomi kong sorë ga eni.
»¿Bomi woydagaga woydomirë dö wl̈eni ga pjãy potjwl̈ẽkkl̈o l̇l̇ë l̈ëmiro? Nopga owa ëmdë ga omshäryë e kjoyoe.
¿Bomi kjimtagaga kjimtomirë erö ga pjãy potjwl̈ẽkkl̈o l̇l̇ë l̈ëmiro? Nopga owa ëmdë ga omshäryë e kjoyo bakoe.
¿Dbur poskwomi, tjwl̈õ shimi iröng wl̈o dö ga pjãy potjwl̈ẽkkl̈o l̇l̇ë l̈ëmiro? Nopga owa ëmdë ga omshäryë e kjoyoe.

Eni l̇l̇ëme. Nopga kong l̇l̇ëbo shärye Sbörë pjl̈ú bako, “Tja kjimtara Sbörë” l̈e l̇l̇ëm gueniyo. E kjĩshko ga bomi moskwoga woydozĩ ara. L̇l̇ëbo shäryozĩ pjl̈ú ba kong. Dbur poskwõzĩ oba kong, ga tjwl̈õ shimi l̇l̇ëme. Eni ga bomi potjwl̈ẽkkl̈o ber kësbange. Ga pjãy ber l̈öng Sbö Tjwl̈õ Kësbangyo l̈i wapga jl̈õkoyo.
Pja songe l̈e bomi Datarë oba kong. Pja songe l̈ozĩ oba kong eni bakoe.
«No obl̈ë l̇l̇ëbo owa shäryono» l̈ëy ë kong l̇l̇ëme

»“No obl̈ë l̇l̇ëbo owa shäryono” l̈ëy ë kong l̇l̇ëme. Eni ga “Pjãy l̇l̇ëbo shäryono owa” l̈e Sbörë bomi kong l̇l̇ëm bakoe. “Pja shdungko” l̈ëy ë kong l̇l̇ëme. Eni ga “Pjãy shdungko” l̈e Sbörë bomi kong l̇l̇ëm bakoe. L̇l̇ëbo shäryara obl̈ërë bomi kong owa l̈i iozĩ ber tjwl̈õ l̇l̇ëme. Eni ga owa pjang bomi go l̈i l̈ö̃ya Sbörë ber dret eni bakoe.

Oba së̃zĩa. Eni ga pjãy së̃ya Sbörë bakoe. Pjãy kong l̇l̇ëbo twe bayo ara, so resgwo bapkwo tjung kjoyo, resgwo bapkwo l̈i roshko resgwo yoroy, kjing l̇l̇iy or go, sigwo yoy ber l̇l̇iktëng wl̈o, kjing goshko iëy jek obi, ber tjung kjopkwo shopte jong om go wl̈eni. Shäryëmi obl̈ë kong sorë ga shärye Sbörë bomi kong eni bakoe» l̈e.

E irgo ga tjl̈ẽno ba kong l̇l̇ëbo jyãgl̈o go obi. Tjl̈ẽ ga «Nopga tjeng do pjök kjok ĩgö l̇l̇ëm wl̈eniyo. ¿Kjl̈ara wl̈osöya ba kjl̈ara l̈irë l̈e ga l̈on jer tjeng pjöyĩkong pjl̈ëbgwo kjwaraso roy l̇l̇ëmdo?
Oppinggaga tjwl̈õ ara, ba pingga kjinmo l̇l̇ëme. Gueniyo ga oppino pjirshko ga äär ber ba pingga dik.
»Bomi kjl̈ara bok bäng kjor pjl̈oyo ĩmi kjër. E wopro ga bomi bok roshko kjorkwang buk kjwangna l̈i ĩgömi l̇l̇ëme. ¿Shäryëmi eni egaro?

¿Kjorkwang buk bomi bok roshko l̈i ĩgömi l̇l̇ëm ga “Kjor pjl̈oyo buk bop bok bäng kjwe shir bop kong” l̈ëmi bomi kjl̈ara kong sorëro? ¡Pjãy Sbö tjl̈õkwo söga jl̈õkoyo l̈ëmi, gueniyo pjãy wotjl̈ĩk owa bomi pjl̈úshko! Kjorkwang buk bomi bok roshko l̈i shizĩ bäm go. Enira kjor pjl̈oyo buk bomi kjl̈ara bok bäng l̈i ĩgömi wẽl̈ë, shimi ba kong wl̈o.
Kjor, e sorë miydëy ba bo go
»Kjor doyo pjl̈ú ga botjyë ga owayo drete. Kjor doyo owa ga botjyë ga pjl̈úyo dret bakoe.
Kjor, e sorë miydëy ba bo go. Kjor bo kjrëy shkl̈ik doyo go l̇l̇ëme. Kjil̇l̇gwo bo kjrëy shkö sho doyo go l̇l̇ëm bakoe.
No pjl̈ú ga tjl̈ẽ pjl̈ú, wotjl̈ĩk pjl̈ú ba pjl̈úshko kjĩshko. No owa ga tjl̈ẽ owa, wotjl̈ĩk owa ba pjl̈úshko kjĩshko bakoe. L̇l̇ëbo tjeng bomi pjl̈úshko l̈omirë bomi kjamo go.
U shäryëy sorë
»Pjãy tjl̈ẽ bor kong ga “Pja bor Tjl̈apga jl̈õkoyo” l̈ëmi, gueniyo tja kol̈ëmi l̇l̇ëme. ¿Shäryëmi eni egaro?

Ëye tjwe bor shwoy, tja tjl̈õkwo kuya, ga l̇l̇ëye l̈oror l̈i shärye ga e so domer u ywaga kjl̈ara kjoyoe. U shäryarashko ga shwl̈eyo pjl̈ona rong, ga ak iara ba so bäng pjribrie. Shäryara pjir ga di to jer, pjono u l̈i goshko ga to wito l̇l̇ëm, u l̈i shäryara pjl̈ú kjĩshko.

Gueniyo ëye, tja tjl̈õkwo kuya, ga l̇l̇ëye l̈oror l̈i shärye l̇l̇ëm ga e so domer u ywaga obl̈ë kjoyoe. U shäryarashko ga ba shwl̈eyo pjl̈ona uriso, rong l̇l̇ëme. Shäryara pjir ga di to jer, pjono u l̈i goshko ga skwara pjir, söra dirë drete» l̈e.
